gifts.title: A clear, dated comfort & safety policy posted at the door
gifts.for_complaint: Loitering, homeless harassment, and safety incidents inside the cafe
gifts.deliverable: A one-page printable sign + matching web page (URL) titled 'Atomic Coffee is for everyone — here's how we keep it that way,' naming 222 Broadway N's actual layout (open floor plan, meeting room in back), a plain-language seating/purchase policy, and a 'tell a barista, we'll handle it' line — built directly off the Feb 2026 review describing a customer driven out by harassment.
gifts.inputs_needed: Their current posted hours/late-night schedule (from atomiccoffeefm.com, which returns 200 now) so the sign can reference actual closing times; no login or contact required.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It quotes their own most damaging recent review back at them and hands over the exact fix as a printable page they can tape up before their next shift — not a strategy memo about 'customer experience.'

gifts.title: A 'ring the bell' sign so the bell you already have gets used
gifts.for_complaint: Ignored at the counter / staff unresponsive despite a call bell existing
gifts.deliverable: A small printable counter/table sign and a QR-linked one-pager saying exactly where to stand and that a bell exists for service — because a 2023 review shows Atomic already owns a bell customers don't know to use, which is why five other reviewers describe standing unacknowledged for minutes.
gifts.inputs_needed: None beyond the counter layout implied by reviews; fully buildable from the review text alone.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It's not 'train your staff to be nicer' — it points at physical infrastructure they already paid for that customers don't know exists, with a one-sentence fix.

gifts.title: One real page explaining what the back room actually costs
gifts.for_complaint: Meeting-room booking terms are unclear/contradictory (price, minimum, hours)
gifts.deliverable: A hosted HTML one-pager, 'Reserve the Back Room at Atomic Coffee, 222 Broadway N,' laying out the room's known terms as reported by four different customers over four years ($25/multi-hour slot vs. $25 minimum spend vs. 'not sure what it costs'), flagged clearly as customer-reported pending their confirmation, with their already-public phone number as the next step.
gifts.inputs_needed: Atomic's current room pricing/policy to replace the 'as reported by guests' placeholder with an authoritative number — reachable by visiting atomiccoffeefm.com (live, 200) or their public phone listing; not reachable without that confirmation for the price itself, but the page is usable and honest today as-is.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: Four paying groups over four years describe four different room policies — this is revenue they're already generating with zero public page to sell it, unlike the report's generic 'build a catering menu' finding.
